{"operationName":"uspSearch","query":"query uspSearch($authToken: String, $pickupDateTime: String!, $returnDateTime: String!, $apc: String, $clientCountryCode: String, $combineRates: Boolean, $currencyCode: String, $detailsKey: String, $driveComponentKey: String, $ipaddr: String, $isPackage: Boolean, $isUsOrCa: Boolean, $isSignedIn: Boolean, $lang: String, $minNumFilterItems: Int, $offerToken: String, $onlyExpressDeals: Boolean, $paidSearchCode: String, $partnerCodes: String, $partnerCollections: String, $partnerCorpDiscountCode: String, $partnerCorpDiscountNumbers: String, $partnerLoyaltyCodes: String, $partnerPromotionCode: String, $partnerPromotionCodes: String, $partnerRateCode: String, $partnerRateCodes: String, $partnerRefId: String, $partnerSourceId: String, $plfCode: String, $queryType: String!, $rateOptions: RcRateOptionsInput, $removePartner: String, $removeVehicleId: String, $rguid: String, $securityDeposit: String, $sessionKey: String!, $sort: String, $sourceId: String!, $totalCost: Float, $totalCostPerTraveler: Float, $travelers: RcTravelersInput!, $useDailyPrice: Boolean, $uspPickupLocation: RcLocationInput!, $uspReturnLocation: RcLocationInput!, $vehicleCodes: String) {
  uspSearch(
    pickupDateTime: $pickupDateTime
    returnDateTime: $returnDateTime
    pickupLocation: $uspPickupLocation
    returnLocation: $uspReturnLocation
    apc: $apc
    authToken: $authToken
    clientCountryCode: $clientCountryCode
    combineRates: $combineRates
    currencyCode: $currencyCode
    detailsKey: $detailsKey
    driveComponentKey: $driveComponentKey
    ipaddr: $ipaddr
    isPackage: $isPackage
    isSignedIn: $isSignedIn
    isUsOrCa: $isUsOrCa
    lang: $lang
    minNumFilterItems: $minNumFilterItems
    offerToken: $offerToken
    onlyExpressDeals: $onlyExpressDeals
    paidSearchCode: $paidSearchCode
    partnerCodes: $partnerCodes
    partnerCollections: $partnerCollections
    partnerCorpDiscountCode: $partnerCorpDiscountCode
    partnerCorpDiscountNumbers: $partnerCorpDiscountNumbers
    partnerLoyaltyCodes: $partnerLoyaltyCodes
    partnerPromotionCode: $partnerPromotionCode
    partnerPromotionCodes: $partnerPromotionCodes
    partnerRateCode: $partnerRateCode
    partnerRateCodes: $partnerRateCodes
    partnerRefId: $partnerRefId
    partnerSourceId: $partnerSourceId
    plfCode: $plfCode
    queryType: $queryType
    rateOptions: $rateOptions
    removePartner: $removePartner
    removeVehicleId: $removeVehicleId
    rguid: $rguid
    securityDeposit: $securityDeposit
    sessionKey: $sessionKey
    sourceId: $sourceId
    totalCost: $totalCost
    totalCostPerTraveler: $totalCostPerTraveler
    travelers: $travelers
    useDailyPrice: $useDailyPrice
    vehicleCodes: $vehicleCodes
  ) {
    pickupDateTime
    pickupTime
    returnDateTime
    returnTime
    totalCost
    totalCostPerTraveler
    airports {
      airportCode
      city
      countryName
      displayName
      distances {
        distanceType
        miles
      }
      fullDisplayName
      isoCountryCode
      latitude
      longitude
      provinceCode
    }
    counterRatings {
      partnerLocations {
        id
        averageRating
        numberOfReviews
        ratings {
          ratingCategoryType
          numberOfReviews
          rating
          text
        }
      }
      categories {
        ratingCategoryType
        ratingLabel
      }
    }
    filters {
      id
      allFiltersLabel
      analyticsAction
      heading
      filterItems {
        id
        analyticsAction
        analyticsEvent
        analyticsLabel
        count
        currency
        currencyCode
        filterGroupDisplayOrder
        filterGroupId
        filterGroupLabel
        filterId
        imageUrl
        key
        label
        labelDescription
        maxBagCapacity
        maxPeopleCapacity
        minPrice
        minTotalPrice
        priceEnd
        priceRange
        priceStart
        vehicleCodes
      }
    }
    gaData {
      advancedPurchase
      apAndLos
      lengthOfStay
    }
    packageComponents
    partnerLocations {
      address {
        addressLine1
        cityName
        countryName
        isoCountryCode
        postalCode
        provinceCode
      }
      airportCode
      airportCounterType
      bookingAirportCounterType
      id
      latitude
      longitude
      partnerCode
      partnerLocationCode
    }
    vehicles(sort: $sort) {
      dealType
      id
      itemKey
      score
      dealCampaign
      groupId
      categoryIds
      code
      name
      nameDisplay
      numRentalDays
      expressLogos {
        name
        image88X44
        partnerCode
      }
      example
      exampleDisplay
      imageUrl
      isExactMakeAndModel
      isPreRegistrationSupported
      isPreRegistrationRequired
      isRequestedRate
      isSkipCounterSupported
      preCheckInDisplay
      preCheckInDescriptionDisplay
      partner {
        name
        nameShort
        code
        url
      }
      vehicleFeatures {
        bagCapacity
        peopleCapacity
        partnerChoiceVehicle
        mileage
        mileageUnit
        isAC
        isHybrid
        isUnlimitedMileage
        isLimitedForLocalRenter
        isPayAtBooking
        transmission
        fuelType
      }
      pickupLocation {
        locationId
        displayName
        airportCode
        counterRating
        counterType
        counterDisplayName
        cityName
        city
        countryCode
        countryName
        lat
        line1
        lng
        postalCode
        provinceCode
        distanceFromSearchLocation
        isExactAddress
        isExactAddressDisplay
      }
      returnLocation {
        locationId
        displayName
        airportCode
        counterType
        counterDisplayName
        isExactAddress
        isExactAddressDisplay
      }
      rate {
        isPrepay
        currencyCode
        currencySymbol
        strikeTotalPrice
        totalPrice
        isFreeCancellation
        detailsKey
        dailyPrice
        ratePlan
        rateDistance {
          extraChargePerUnit
        }
        isCancellationAllowed
        isCreditCardRequired
        isVip
        tags
        couponSavingsPercent
        couponSavingsDaily
        couponSavingsTotal
      }
      secretText
      packagePriceFromUsp {
        currencyCode
        currencySymbol
        originalCostPerTraveler
        roomMandatoryFees
        totalCost
        totalCostPerTraveler
        totalCostWithHotelMandatoryFees
        totalHotelMandatoryFees
        totalPayLater
        totalPayNow
        totalSavings
        totalStrikethrough
      }
    }
  }
